_common.csrf_error_desc: The request was blocked by CSRF protection. If you are accessing Sunshine from a non-default URL or reverse proxy, add that origin to the 'csrf_allowed_origins' option in your configuration.

apps.app_name_desc: Application Name, as shown on Moonlight
apps.applications_desc: Applications are refreshed only when Client is restarted
apps.auto_detach: Continue streaming if the application exits quickly
apps.auto_detach_desc: This will attempt to automatically detect launcher-type apps that close quickly after launching another program or instance of themselves. When a launcher-type app is detected, it is treated as a detached app.
apps.cmd_desc: The main application to start. If blank, no application will be started.
apps.cmd_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in double quotes.
apps.cmd_prep_desc: A list of commands to be run before/after this application. If any of the prep-commands fail, starting the application is aborted.
apps.cover_search_hint: Search names should match IGDB naming conventions.
apps.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {name}?
apps.detached_cmds_desc: A list of commands to be run in the background.
apps.detached_cmds_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in double quotes.
apps.env_client_audio_config: The Audio Configuration requested by the client (2.0/5.1/7.1)
apps.env_client_enable_sops: The client has requested the option to optimize the game for optimal streaming (true/false)
apps.env_client_fps: The FPS requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_gcmap: The requested gamepad mask, in a bitset/bitfield format (int)
apps.env_client_hdr: HDR is enabled by the client (true/false)
apps.env_client_height: The Height requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_host_audio: The client has requested host audio (true/false)
apps.env_client_width: The Width requested by the client (int)
apps.env_vars_desc: All commands get these environment variables by default:
apps.exit_timeout_desc: Number of seconds to wait for all app processes to gracefully exit when requested to quit. If unset, the default is to wait up to 5 seconds. If set to 0, the app will be immediately terminated.
apps.global_prep_desc: Enable/Disable the execution of Global Prep Commands for this application.
apps.image_desc: Application icon/picture/image path that will be sent to client. Image must be a PNG file. If not set, Sunshine will send default box image.
apps.name: Name
apps.no_applications: No applications have been added yet
apps.output_desc: The file where the output of the command is stored, if it is not specified, the output is ignored
apps.run_as_desc: This can be necessary for some applications that require administrator permissions to run properly.
apps.wait_all: Continue streaming until all app processes exit
apps.wait_all_desc: This will continue streaming until all processes started by the app have terminated. When unchecked, streaming will stop when the initial app process exits, even if other app processes are still running.
apps.working_dir_desc: The working directory that should be passed to the process. For example, some applications use the working directory to search for configuration files. If not set, Sunshine will default to the parent directory of the command

config.adapter_name_desc_linux_1: Manually specify a GPU to use for capture.
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_2: to find all devices capable of VAAPI
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_3: Replace ``renderD129`` with the device from above to lists the name and capabilities of the device. To be supported by Sunshine, it needs to have at the very minimum:
config.adapter_name_desc_windows: Manually specify a GPU to use for capture. If unset, the GPU is chosen automatically. We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic GPU selection! Note: This GPU must have a display connected and powered on. The appropriate values can be found using the following command:
config.address_family_desc: Set the address family used by Sunshine
config.always_send_scancodes_desc: Sending scancodes enhances compatibility with games and apps but may result in incorrect keyboard input from certain clients that aren't using a US English keyboard layout. Enable if keyboard input is not working at all in certain applications. Disable if keys on the client are generating the wrong input on the host.
config.amd_coder_desc: Allows you to select the entropy encoding to prioritize quality or encoding speed. H.264 only.
config.amd_enforce_hrd_desc: Increases the constraints on rate control to meet HRD model requirements. This greatly reduces bitrate overflows, but may cause encoding artifacts or reduced quality on certain cards.
config.amd_preanalysis_desc: This enables rate-control preanalysis, which may increase quality at the expense of increased encoding latency.
config.amd_quality_desc: This controls the balance between encoding speed and quality.
config.amd_rc_cbr: cbr -- constant bitrate (recommended if HRD is enabled)
config.amd_rc_desc: This controls the rate control method to ensure we are not exceeding the client bitrate target. 'cqp' is not suitable for bitrate targeting, and other options besides 'vbr_latency' depend on HRD Enforcement to help constrain bitrate overflows.
config.amd_rc_vbr_latency: vbr_latency -- latency constrained variable bitrate (recommended if HRD is disabled; default)
config.amd_usage_desc: This sets the base encoding profile. All options presented below will override a subset of the usage profile, but there are additional hidden settings applied that cannot be configured elsewhere.
config.amd_vbaq_desc: The human visual system is typically less sensitive to artifacts in highly textured areas. In VBAQ mode, pixel variance is used to indicate the complexity of spatial textures, allowing the encoder to allocate more bits to smoother areas. Enabling this feature leads to improvements in subjective visual quality with some content.
config.apply_note: Click 'Apply' to restart Sunshine and apply changes. This will terminate any running sessions.
config.audio_sink_desc_linux: The name of the audio sink used for Audio Loopback. If you do not specify this variable, pulseaudio will select the default monitor device. You can find the name of the audio sink using either command:
config.audio_sink_desc_macos: The name of the audio sink used for Audio Loopback. Leave this blank to use the built-in system audio capture. Alternatively, specify a virtual device such as Soundflower or BlackHole if you prefer.
config.audio_sink_desc_windows: Manually specify a specific audio device to capture. If unset, the device is chosen automatically. We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic device selection! If you have multiple audio devices with identical names, you can get the Device ID using the following command:
config.av1_mode_0: Sunshine will advertise support for AV1 based on encoder capabilities (recommended)
config.av1_mode_1: Sunshine will not advertise support for AV1
config.av1_mode_2: Sunshine will advertise support for AV1 Main 8-bit profile
config.av1_mode_3: Sunshine will advertise support for AV1 Main 8-bit and 10-bit (HDR) profiles
config.av1_mode_desc: Allows the client to request AV1 Main 8-bit or 10-bit video streams. AV1 is more CPU-intensive to encode, so enabling this may reduce performance when using software encoding.
config.back_button_timeout_desc: If the Back/Select button is held down for the specified number of milliseconds, a Home/Guide button press is emulated. If set to a value < 0 (default), holding the Back/Select button will not emulate the Home/Guide button.
config.bind_address_desc: Set the specific IP address Sunshine will bind to. If left blank, Sunshine will bind to all available addresses.
config.capture_desc: On automatic mode Sunshine will use the first one that works. NvFBC requires patched nvidia drivers.
config.cert_desc: The certificate used for the web UI and Moonlight client pairing. For best compatibility, this should have an RSA-2048 public key.
config.channels_desc_1: Sunshine can allow a single streaming session to be shared with multiple clients simultaneously.
config.channels_desc_2: Some hardware encoders may have limitations that reduce performance with multiple streams.
config.coder_cabac: cabac -- context adaptive binary arithmetic coding - higher quality
config.coder_cavlc: cavlc -- context adaptive variable-length coding - faster decode
config.configuration_desc: Configure Sunshine's host settings to match your streaming setup.
config.compositor_backend_desc: Headless display backend. auto detects KWin and prefers krfb-virtualmonitor, falling back to labwc for other Wayland compositors.
config.headless_width_desc: Override the headless virtual display width in pixels. 0 follows the client's requested resolution.
config.headless_height_desc: Override the headless virtual display height in pixels. 0 follows the client's requested resolution.
config.headless_refresh_desc: Override the headless virtual display refresh rate in Hz. 0 follows the client's requested framerate.
config.controller_desc: Allows guests to control the host system with a gamepad / controller
config.input_seat_desc: Systemd-logind seat name for virtual input device isolation (e.g. seat1). Leave empty to follow XDG_SEAT. Set to seat0 or leave empty to disable isolation. Create a seat with: loginctl seat-add seat1
config.credentials_file_desc: Store Username/Password separately from Sunshine's state file.
config.csrf_allowed_origins_desc: Comma-separated list of additional allowed origins for CSRF protection (appended to defaults: localhost variants and web UI port). Only add origins you trust. Each origin must include protocol and host (e.g., https://example.com).
config.dd_config_ensure_only_display: Deactivate other displays and activate only the specified display
config.dd_config_ensure_primary: Activate the display automatically and make it a primary display
config.dd_config_revert_delay_desc: Additional delay in milliseconds to wait before reverting configuration when the app has been closed or the last session terminated. Main purpose is to provide a smoother transition when quickly switching between apps.
config.dd_config_revert_on_disconnect_desc: Revert configuration upon disconnect of all clients instead of app close or last session termination.
config.dd_config_verify_only: Verify that the display is enabled
config.dd_hdr_option_auto: Switch on/off the HDR mode as requested by the client (default)
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_1: Specify remapping entries to change the requested resolution and/or refresh rate to other values.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_2: The list is iterated from top to bottom and the first match is used.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_3: "Requested" fields can be left empty to match any requested value.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_4_final_values_mi: At least one "Final" field must be specified. The unspecified resolution or refresh rate will not be changed.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_4_final_values_no: "Final" field must be specified and cannot be empty.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_5_sops_mixed_only: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled in the Moonlight client, otherwise entries with any resolution fields specified are skipped.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_5_sops_resolution: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled in the Moonlight client, otherwise the mapping is skipped.
config.dd_refresh_rate_option_auto: Use FPS value provided by the client (default)
config.dd_resolution_option_auto: Use resolution provided by the client (default)
config.dd_resolution_option_ogs_desc: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled on the Moonlight client for this to work.
config.dd_wa_hdr_toggle_delay_desc_1: When using virtual display device (VDD) for streaming, it might incorrectly display HDR color. Sunshine can try to mitigate this issue, by turning HDR off and then on again.
config.dd_wa_hdr_toggle_delay_desc_2: If the value is set to 0, the workaround is disabled (default). If the value is between 0 and 3000 milliseconds, Sunshine will turn off HDR, wait for the specified amount of time and then turn HDR on again. The recommended delay time is around 500 milliseconds in most cases.
config.dd_wa_hdr_toggle_delay_desc_3: DO NOT use this workaround unless you actually have issues with HDR as it directly impacts stream start time!
config.ds4_back_as_touchpad_click_desc: When forcing DS4 emulation, map Back/Select to Touchpad Click
config.ds5_inputtino_randomize_mac_desc: Upon controller registration use a random MAC instead of one based on the controllers internal index to avoid mixing configuration settings of different controllers when the are swapped on client-side.
config.encoder_desc: Force a specific encoder, otherwise Sunshine will select the best available option. Note: If you specify a hardware encoder on Windows, it must match the GPU where the display is connected.
config.external_ip_desc: If no external IP address is given, Sunshine will automatically detect external IP
config.fec_percentage_desc: Percentage of error correcting packets per data packet in each video frame. Higher values can correct for more network packet loss, but at the cost of increasing bandwidth usage.
config.file_apps_desc: The file where current apps of Sunshine are stored.
config.file_state_desc: The file where current state of Sunshine is stored
config.gamepad_desc: Choose which type of gamepad to emulate on the host
config.global_prep_cmd_desc: Configure a list of commands to be executed before or after running any application. If any of the specified preparation commands fail, the application launch process will be aborted.
config.headless_mode_desc: Run games in a private headless compositor instead of hijacking the desktop. Games launch inside an isolated compositor environment.
config.hevc_mode_0: Sunshine will advertise support for HEVC based on encoder capabilities (recommended)
config.hevc_mode_1: Sunshine will not advertise support for HEVC
config.hevc_mode_2: Sunshine will advertise support for HEVC Main profile
config.hevc_mode_3: Sunshine will advertise support for HEVC Main and Main10 (HDR) profiles
config.hevc_mode_desc: Allows the client to request HEVC Main or HEVC Main10 video streams. HEVC is more CPU-intensive to encode, so enabling this may reduce performance when using software encoding.
config.high_resolution_scrolling_desc: When enabled, Sunshine will pass through high resolution scroll events from Moonlight clients. This can be useful to disable for older applications that scroll too fast with high resolution scroll events.
config.install_steam_audio_drivers_desc: If Steam is installed, this will automatically install the Steam Streaming Speakers driver to support 5.1/7.1 surround sound and muting host audio.
config.key_repeat_delay_desc: Control how fast keys will repeat themselves. The initial delay in milliseconds before repeating keys.
config.key_repeat_frequency_desc: How often keys repeat every second. This configurable option supports decimals.
config.key_rightalt_to_key_win: Map Right Alt key to Windows key
config.key_rightalt_to_key_win_desc: It may be possible that you cannot send the Windows Key from Moonlight directly. In those cases it may be useful to make Sunshine think the Right Alt key is the Windows key
config.keyboard_desc: Allows guests to control the host system with the keyboard
config.lan_encryption_mode_desc: This determines when encryption will be used when streaming over your local network. Encryption can reduce streaming performance, particularly on less powerful hosts and clients.
config.linux_prefer_gpu_native_capture_desc: Prefer DMA-BUF GPU-native capture even if a windowed labwc compositor is needed. When disabled, the system may fall back to a simpler capture path.
config.linux_use_cage_compositor_desc: Route launched applications into a labwc nested Wayland compositor for headless streaming. Requires headless mode to be enabled.
config.locale_desc: The locale used for Sunshine's user interface.
config.log_path_desc: The file where the current logs of Sunshine are stored.
config.max_bitrate_desc: The maximum bitrate (in Kbps) that Sunshine will encode the stream at. If set to 0, it will always use the bitrate requested by Moonlight.
config.min_log_level_desc: The minimum log level printed to standard out
config.min_threads_desc: Increasing the value slightly reduces encoding efficiency, but the tradeoff is usually worth it to gain the use of more CPU cores for encoding. The ideal value is the lowest value that can reliably encode at your desired streaming settings on your hardware.
config.minimum_fps_target_desc: The lowest effective FPS a stream can reach. A value of 0 is treated as roughly half of the stream's FPS. A setting of 20 is recommended if you stream 24 or 30fps content.
config.motion_as_ds4: Emulate a DS4 gamepad if the client gamepad reports motion sensors are present
config.motion_as_ds4_desc: If disabled, motion sensors will not be taken into account during gamepad type selection.
config.mouse_desc: Allows guests to control the host system with the mouse
config.native_pen_touch_desc: When enabled, Sunshine will pass through native pen/touch events from Moonlight clients. This can be useful to disable for older applications without native pen/touch support.
config.notify_pre_releases_desc: Whether to be notified of new pre-release versions of Sunshine
config.nvenc_aq_strength_desc: When Spatial AQ is enabled, controls how aggressively the encoder redistributes bits across the frame. 1 = subtle, 15 = aggressive. Default 8. Higher values save more bitrate on flat regions at the cost of more visible quality loss in busy regions.
config.nvenc_bframes_desc: B-frames between P-frames. 0 = no B-frames (lowest latency, required for sub-frame streaming). 2-4 = better compression at the cost of pipeline latency. Ignored when zero-latency tune is on.
config.nvenc_enable_min_qp_desc: Prevents the encoder from going below a per-codec minimum QP. Useful for capping peak quality to save bitrate on scenes the encoder would otherwise over-allocate to.
config.nvenc_filler_data_desc: Adds filler data to encoded frames to maintain target bitrate even when the source content compresses below it. Useful for network testing only; off by default.
config.nvenc_h264_cavlc: Prefer CAVLC over CABAC in H.264
config.nvenc_h264_cavlc_desc: Simpler form of entropy coding. CAVLC needs around 10% more bitrate for same quality. Only relevant for really old decoding devices.
config.nvenc_latency_over_power: Prefer lower encoding latency over power savings
config.nvenc_latency_over_power_desc: Sunshine requests maximum GPU clock speed while streaming to reduce encoding latency. Disabling it is not recommended since this can lead to significantly increased encoding latency.
config.nvenc_min_qp_av1_desc: Lower bound for AV1 QP when min-QP clamp is enabled. Higher = more bitrate saved on easy scenes. Range 1-255. Default 23.
config.nvenc_min_qp_h264_desc: Lower bound for H.264 QP when min-QP clamp is enabled. Higher = more bitrate saved on easy scenes. Range 1-51. Default 19.
config.nvenc_min_qp_hevc_desc: Lower bound for HEVC QP when min-QP clamp is enabled. Higher = more bitrate saved on easy scenes. Range 1-51. Default 23.
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi: Present OpenGL/Vulkan on top of DXGI
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi_desc: Sunshine can't capture fullscreen OpenGL and Vulkan programs at full frame rate unless they present on top of DXGI. This is system-wide setting that is reverted on sunshine program exit.
config.nvenc_preset_desc: Higher numbers improve compression (quality at given bitrate) at the cost of increased encoding latency. Recommended to change only when limited by network or decoder, otherwise similar effect can be accomplished by increasing bitrate.
config.nvenc_rc_lookahead_desc: Number of frames the encoder looks ahead to anticipate bitrate needs. 0 = disabled (lowest latency). 20-40 = good quality / latency trade-off for most content. Capped at 31 by the NVENC API. Ignored when zero-latency tune is on.
config.nvenc_realtime_hags: Use realtime priority in hardware accelerated gpu scheduling
config.nvenc_realtime_hags_desc: Currently NVIDIA drivers may freeze in encoder when HAGS is enabled, realtime priority is used and VRAM utilization is close to maximum. Disabling this option lowers the priority to high, sidestepping the freeze at the cost of reduced capture performance when the GPU is heavily loaded.
config.nvenc_spatial_aq_desc: Assign higher QP values to flat regions of the video. Recommended to enable when streaming at lower bitrates.
config.nvenc_split_encode_desc: Split the encoding of each video frame over multiple NVENC hardware units. Significantly reduces host processing latency with a marginal compression efficiency penalty. The default option enables SFE if the following conditions are met: there are 2+ NVENC units, the stream is 4K resolution or higher, and the preset is P1-P4. Set this to Enabled to use SFE at lower resolutions or higher presets.
config.nvenc_surfaces_desc: Number of encode surfaces managed by the NVENC driver. More surfaces allow better encoder pipelining at the cost of GPU memory. Set to -1 to let the driver choose the default. Range: -1 (driver default) or 1-32.
config.nvenc_temporal_aq_desc: Redistributes bits across frames instead of within a frame. Pairs with Spatial AQ. Especially useful for content with rapidly changing scenes (gameplay with frequent cuts).
config.nvenc_tuning_preset_desc: One-click NVENC tuning. Manual leaves every other nvenc_* knob untouched; the three presets auto-fill the knobs below with recommended values for latency-optimised, balanced, or quality-optimised streaming. Auto-filled values can still be tweaked before saving.
config.nvenc_tuning_preset_latency: Latency-optimised (P1, no B-frames, zero-latency tune, no lookahead)
config.nvenc_tuning_preset_quality: Quality-optimised (P7, 4 B-frames, 40-frame lookahead, full two-pass, min-QP)
config.nvenc_twopass_desc: Adds preliminary encoding pass. This allows to detect more motion vectors, better distribute bitrate across the frame and more strictly adhere to bitrate limits. Disabling it is not recommended since this can lead to occasional bitrate overshoot and subsequent packet loss.
config.nvenc_vbv_increase_desc: By default sunshine uses single-frame VBV/HRD, which means any encoded video frame size is not expected to exceed requested bitrate divided by requested frame rate. Relaxing this restriction can be beneficial and act as low-latency variable bitrate, but may also lead to packet loss if the network doesn't have buffer headroom to handle bitrate spikes. Maximum accepted value is 400, which corresponds to 5x increased encoded video frame upper size limit.
config.nvenc_weighted_prediction_desc: Uses B-frame weighted prediction to improve the compression of fade-in / fade-out transitions. Costs a small amount of CUDA cores. Default off; recommended on for cinematic content.
config.nvenc_zerolatency_desc: Mirrors FFmpeg's tune=zerolatency: forces no lookahead, no B-frames, single-pass encoding. Every ms of encoder pipeline budget goes to the encoder instead of frame reordering. Recommended for interactive gaming streaming.
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_desc: The origin of the remote endpoint address that is not denied access to Web UI
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_lan: Only those in LAN may access Web UI
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_pc: Only localhost may access Web UI
config.output_name_desc_macos: During Sunshine startup, you should see the list of detected displays. Note: You need to use the id value inside the parenthesis. Below is an example; the actual output can be found in the Troubleshooting tab.
config.output_name_desc_unix: During Sunshine startup, you should see the list of detected displays. Note: It is recommended to use the display's connector name (e.g. DP-0) but depending on the capture backend used other values may be possible (see documentation for details). Below is an example; the actual output can be found in the Troubleshooting tab.
config.output_name_desc_windows: Manually specify a display device id to use for capture. If unset, the primary display is captured. Note: If you specified a GPU above, this display must be connected to that GPU. During Sunshine startup, you should see the list of detected displays. Below is an example; the actual output can be found in the Troubleshooting tab.
config.packetsize_desc: Limit the packet size to avoid fragmentation on a low MTU link. This helps reduce packet loss and micro-stuttering, while streaming over a layer 2 VPN to clients that cannot configure this value, e.g. Moonlight for Android/iOS. Reduce the bitrate when using low values. Values larger than 1456 require jumbo frames. Range: 0, 200-65535. A value of 0 will disable the limit.
config.ping_timeout_desc: How long to wait in milliseconds for data from moonlight before shutting down the stream
config.pkey_desc: The private key used for the web UI and Moonlight client pairing. For best compatibility, this should be an RSA-2048 private key.
config.port_desc: Set the family of ports used by Sunshine
config.port_http_port_note: Use this port to connect with Moonlight.
config.port_warning: Exposing the Web UI to the internet is a security risk! Proceed at your own risk!
config.qp_desc: Some devices may not support Constant Bit Rate. For those devices, QP is used instead. Higher value means more compression, but less quality.
config.qsv_slow_hevc_desc: This can enable HEVC encoding on older Intel GPUs, at the cost of higher GPU usage and worse performance.
config.restart_note: Sunshine is restarting to apply changes.
config.stream_audio_desc: Whether to stream audio or not. Disabling this can be useful for streaming headless displays as second monitors.
config.sunshine_name_desc: The name displayed by Moonlight. If not specified, the PC's hostname is used
config.sw_preset_desc: Optimize the trade-off between encoding speed (encoded frames per second) and compression efficiency (quality per bit in the bitstream). Defaults to superfast.
config.sw_tune_animation: animation -- good for cartoons; uses higher deblocking and more reference frames
config.sw_tune_desc: Tuning options, which are applied after the preset. Defaults to zerolatency.
config.sw_tune_fastdecode: fastdecode -- allows faster decoding by disabling certain filters
config.sw_tune_film: film -- use for high quality movie content; lowers deblocking
config.sw_tune_grain: grain -- preserves the grain structure in old, grainy film material
config.sw_tune_zerolatency: zerolatency -- good for fast encoding and low-latency streaming (default)
config.system_tray_desc: Show icon in system tray and display desktop notifications
config.touchpad_as_ds4: Emulate a DS4 gamepad if the client gamepad reports a touchpad is present
config.touchpad_as_ds4_desc: If disabled, touchpad presence will not be taken into account during gamepad type selection.
config.upnp_desc: Automatically configure port forwarding for streaming over the Internet
config.vaapi_async_depth_desc: Number of frames the encoder may have in flight. Higher values can improve throughput at the cost of added latency. 0 uses the default of 1.
config.vaapi_max_qp_desc: Maximum QP bound for the VA-API encoder. Caps per-frame quality to flatten encode-time variance. 0 disables.
config.vaapi_min_qp_desc: Minimum QP bound for the VA-API encoder. Caps per-frame quality to flatten encode-time variance. 0 disables.
config.vaapi_quality_desc: Speed/quality trade-off for the VA-API encoder. Lower values produce higher quality at the cost of speed. Valid ranges differ per codec (H.264/AV1: 0-5, HEVC: 0-10). 0 uses the driver default.
config.vaapi_rc_mode_desc: Rate control mode for the VA-API encoder. Auto lets the driver decide. Modes not supported by the driver are ignored with a warning.
config.vaapi_rc_mode_explicit_warning: An explicit rate-control mode is selected. Strict RC Buffer (and the Intel/AV1 defaults) still apply single-frame VBV sizing without changing this mode. Set Buffer Size (frames) to override the VBV length.
config.vaapi_rc_buffer_frames_desc: Size of the rate-control buffer (VBV) in frames of the configured bitrate. 0 uses the automatic single-frame VBV on the strict/Intel/AV1 path (including when an explicit rate-control mode is selected).
config.vaapi_slice_count_desc: Number of slices per frame. 0 uses the slice count requested by the client. Values above the encoder maximum are clamped.
config.vaapi_strict_rc_buffer: Strictly enforce frame bitrate limits for H.264/HEVC on AMD GPUs
config.vaapi_strict_rc_buffer_desc: Enabling this option can avoid dropped frames over the network during scene changes, but video quality may be reduced during motion. With an explicit rate-control mode, this still sizes the VBV to one frame without changing the selected mode.
config.virtual_sink_desc: Manually specify a virtual audio device to use. If unset, the device is chosen automatically. We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic device selection!
config.vk_rc_mode_desc: Rate control mode for encoding. Auto lets the driver decide.
config.vk_min_qp_desc: Minimum QP bound for the Vulkan encoder. Caps per-frame quality to flatten encode-time variance. 0 disables.
config.vk_max_qp_desc: Maximum QP bound for the Vulkan encoder. Caps per-frame quality to flatten encode-time variance. 0 disables.
config.vk_tune_desc: Low latency modes reduce encoding delay at the cost of quality.
config.wan_encryption_mode_desc: This determines when encryption will be used when streaming over the Internet. Encryption can reduce streaming performance, particularly on less powerful hosts and clients.
config.sf_audio_section_desc: Pre-encoder audio effects and Opus tuning. All values default to upstream Sunshine behaviour; enabling any effect changes how the captured audio is processed before Opus encoding.
config.sf_audio_agc_desc: Smooth gain riding so the encoded audio sits closer to a target loudness. Off by default.
config.sf_audio_vad_desc: Detect speech segments to drive ducking and other voice-aware behaviour. Off by default.
config.sf_audio_ducking_desc: When voice is active, briefly reduce the game-audio level so speech is intelligible. Off by default.
config.sf_audio_noise_gate_desc: Suppress signal below a dBFS threshold (kills mic-style noise floor). Off by default.
config.sf_audio_noise_gate_db_desc: Signals below this level are attenuated toward silence. Range -90 to -10. Default -55.
config.sf_audio_agc_target_db_desc: AGC will raise/lower gain to keep output RMS near this level. Default -20.
config.sf_audio_agc_max_gain_db_desc: Maximum gain AGC can apply. Default 12 dB.
config.sf_audio_agc_min_gain_db_desc: Maximum attenuation AGC can apply (negative). Default -12 dB.
config.sf_audio_agc_attack_ms_desc: Time-constant used when raising gain. Default 10 ms.
config.sf_audio_agc_hold_ms_desc: Hold gain at peak before releasing. Default 200 ms.
config.sf_audio_agc_release_ms_desc: Time-constant used when releasing gain. Default 100 ms.
config.sf_audio_vad_threshold_db_desc: RMS level above which the input is considered speech. Default -45.
config.sf_audio_vad_hysteresis_db_desc: Hysteresis below the threshold before flipping back to silence. Default 6.
config.sf_audio_vad_min_speech_ms_desc: Minimum duration above threshold to declare speech. Default 100.
config.sf_audio_vad_min_silence_ms_desc: Minimum silence duration to release speech state. Default 200.
config.sf_audio_ducker_attenuation_db_desc: How much to duck (negative = quieter) when speech is active. Default -12.
config.sf_audio_ducker_attack_ms_desc: Time to reach the ducking target when speech starts. Default 50 ms.
config.sf_audio_ducker_release_ms_desc: Time to release back to unity when speech stops. Default 500 ms.
config.sf_opus_application_desc: 0 = RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY (upstream default), 1 = VOIP (better speech), 2 = AUDIO (better music/SFX).
config.sf_opus_vbr_desc: 0 = CBR (upstream default), 1 = Constrained VBR, 2 = Full VBR. VBR typically gives better quality at the same bitrate.
config.sf_opus_complexity_desc: 0 = lowest CPU / lowest quality, 10 = highest CPU / highest quality. Default 10.
config.sf_opus_fec_desc: Forward error correction: redundant copies of each packet allow the decoder to recover from single-packet loss. Default on.
config.sf_opus_expected_loss_pct_desc: Tell Opus the expected packet-loss percentage so it can pre-allocate FEC bits. 0 disables. Default 0.
config.sf_opus_bandwidth_extension_desc: Allow Opus to use super-wideband / fullband (>16 kHz) modes. Default on.
config.adaptive_bitrate_enabled_desc: SolarFlare addition. Dynamically adjusts encoding bitrate based on encode time, FPS ratio, and client-reported packet loss. EWMA-based with congestion detection and gradual recovery.
config.adaptive_bitrate_min_desc: Minimum bitrate floor in kbps for the SolarFlare adaptive bitrate controller. Range: 100-1000000. Default: 2000.
config.adaptive_bitrate_max_desc: Maximum bitrate ceiling in kbps for the SolarFlare adaptive bitrate controller. Range: 100-1000000. Default: 100000.
config.idle_timeout_min_desc: Automatically stop a stream after this many minutes without client input, freeing the capture/encode pipeline. 0 disables the watchdog. Range: 0-600. Default: 0.
config.trusted_subnet_auto_pairing_desc: Auto-pair clients connecting from IP addresses within the configured trusted subnets, bypassing PIN authentication.
config.webhook_secret_desc: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign stream start/stop webhook payloads. When set, each request carries an X-Solarflare-Signature header so receivers can verify the payload came from this host.
